name: KITTI-360
summary: 面向长期城市驾驶的多模态三维数据集，提供全景图像、激光雷达、轨迹和三维场景标注。
summaryEn: A multimodal 3D dataset for long-range urban driving with panoramic images, LiDAR, trajectories, and scene annotations.
organizations: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and TUM
organizationsZh: 卡尔斯鲁厄理工学院与慕尼黑工大
licenseZh: 适用 CC BY-NC-SA 条款
wmNote: 适合时空场景和占据建模。
wmNoteEn: Useful for spatiotemporal scene and occupancy modeling.

evidence.statement: Official release supplies ordered driving frames with accurate geolocation, consistent instance IDs and released image/LiDAR timestamps.
